getting-started-talking-to-phileas.speaker: Phileas Rimor
getting-started-talking-to-phileas.text: Hello there. Not very often I get visitors. What brings you here?

steps.speaker: Phileas Rimor
steps.text: The name's Phileas Rimor. I was once a soldier in the Shayzien Army but now I'm retired.

steps.player: Do you need help with anything?

options.text: Do you need help with anything?

steps.player: Do you need help with anything?

steps.text: If the player does not have the requirements to start the quest:

steps.speaker: Phileas Rimor
steps.text: I'm fine thank you. Thanks for asking though.
If the player has the requirements to start the quest:

steps.speaker: Phileas Rimor
steps.text: Well let me think...

steps.speaker: Phileas Rimor
steps.text: You know, there is something I wouldn't mind some help with.

steps.player: Great! What is it?

steps.speaker: Phileas Rimor
steps.text: When I was a boy, my grandfather would tell me the story of my ancestor, Magnus Rimor. He was a great explorer who lived a thousand years ago.

steps.speaker: Phileas Rimor
steps.text: One day, Magnus was approached by none other than King Shayzien VII himself. The King asked him to lead an expedition to explore Mount Quidamortem in the Kebos Lowlands.

steps.speaker: Phileas Rimor
steps.text: Alas, according to records, the party never returned and were declared to have perished in the field.

steps.player: That's very interesting and all but why are you telling me this?

steps.speaker: Phileas Rimor
steps.text: A few days ago, I received a parcel. There was no name on it and I never saw the person that delivered it. Inside, I found something truly fascinating.

steps.player: What was it?

steps.speaker: Phileas Rimor
steps.text: There was an old journal, along with a note. The note claims that the journal was stolen from the Tower of Magic during the uprising against Xeric.

steps.speaker: Phileas Rimor
steps.text: But that's not all. Apparently the journal was written by King Shayzien VII himself!

steps.player: Again, really great and all but I still don't see where I come into this.

steps.speaker: Phileas Rimor
steps.text: Most of the journal is illegible but I've still managed to find a few readable extracts. Listen to this one...

steps.speaker: Phileas Rimor
steps.text: 'Quidamortem's creatures are compatible. The experimentation is proving successful and we will soon be ready to mass produce.'

steps.player: So?

steps.speaker: Phileas Rimor
steps.text: That extract had a date in the 37th decade but the expedition was declared a failure in the 36th decade! If the expedition truly was a failure, why was the King writing about Quidamortem years later?

steps.player: Maybe there was another expedition.

steps.speaker: Phileas Rimor
steps.text: Maybe. Or maybe someone wasn't telling the truth about that expedition. Regardless, I must find out what really happened. Can you help me?

steps.prompt: Start the Tale of the Righteous quest?

steps.player: What do you need?

steps.speaker: Phileas Rimor
steps.text: We need to find out more about that expedition. The Library Historical Archive should have records on it. Talk to Archeio in the Arceuus Library. He can take you there.

steps.player: That doesn't sound too hard. Leave it with me.
I've got other things to do.

steps.speaker: Phileas Rimor
steps.text: Oh, okay then.

steps.player: Nothing.

getting-started-talking-to-phileas-talki.speaker: Phileas Rimor
getting-started-talking-to-phileas-talki.text: Hello again. How is your quest going?

getting-started-talking-to-phileas-talki.speaker: Phileas Rimor
getting-started-talking-to-phileas-talki.text: Well you need to find out more about that expedition. The Library Historical Archive should have records on it. Talk to Archeio in the Arceuus Library. He can take you there.

perhaps-the-archives-are-incomplete-talk.speaker: Archeio
perhaps-the-archives-are-incomplete-talk.text: Hello. Would you like to visit the Library Historical Archive? We've recently opened the archive to visitors.

perhaps-the-archives-are-incomplete-talk.speaker: Istoria
perhaps-the-archives-are-incomplete-talk.text: Welcome to the Library Historical Archive.

options.text: I have a question about King Shayzien VII.

steps.player: I have a question about King Shayzien VII.

steps.speaker: Istoria
steps.text: Well you've come to the right place. What would you like to know?

steps.player: I'm searching for information on an expedition to Mount Quidamortem during his reign.

steps.speaker: Istoria
steps.text: Ah yes, I know of that expedition. King Shayzien VII was one of Kourend's most notable rulers. According to the history books, his reign was defined by violence.

steps.speaker: Istoria
steps.text: The expedition to Quidamortem was part of his aggressive plans to expand Kourend's territory. Unfortunately, it was a failure. The entire party was killed.

steps.speaker: Istoria
steps.text: The King himself died a few years later and was succeeded by Xeric, a tyrannical mage who made the King seem meek in comparison. Though of course, many believe them to actually be the same person.

steps.speaker: Istoria
steps.text: But I digress. The key thing to note is that no more expeditions were ordered under King Shayzien VII's rule. Does that help you?

steps.player: No, not really. I have reason to believe that not everyone was killed on that expedition.

steps.speaker: Istoria
steps.text: I'm afraid I can't help you there. All the evidence we have tells us that the expedition had no survivors.

steps.player: So I'm at a dead end?

steps.speaker: Istoria
steps.text: It would seem that way. However, if you do want to learn more about King Shayzien VII, it might be worth talking to Pagida. He's recently been investigating the King's additions to the Tower of Magic.

steps.player: Okay, thanks.

options.text: How do I get out of here?

perhaps-the-archives-are-incomplete-talk.speaker: Pagida
perhaps-the-archives-are-incomplete-talk.text: Hello there, what can I do for you?

options.text: I don't know, what can you do for me?
I have a question about King Shayzien VII.

steps.player: I have a question about King Shayzien VII.

steps.speaker: Pagida
steps.text: What do you wish to know?

steps.player: I'm trying to find out more about the expedition he ordered to Mount Quidamortem.

steps.speaker: Pagida
steps.text: I'm afraid I don't have any information on that expedition. You're probably better off talking to one of the others.

steps.speaker: Pagida
steps.text: I could tell you about the King's work on the Tower of Magic though.

steps.player: Well it's not like I have anything better to do. Fire away.

steps.speaker: Pagida
steps.text: During the time of King Shayzien VII, the Tower of Magic was the seat of power in Kourend. The King spent a lot of his time at the Tower, more than any other ruler.

steps.speaker: Pagida
steps.text: In fact, he oversaw the construction of various new sections, most notably the prison.

steps.player: When was this?

steps.speaker: Pagida
steps.text: Well now that I think about it, it was around the same time as the expedition you were asking about. That said, I doubt the two are connected.

steps.player: I see. Would it be possible to visit the prison?

steps.speaker: Pagida
steps.text: Well the prison is abandoned and has been for many years, so I suppose there's no harm in letting you see it.

steps.speaker: Pagida
steps.text: Be aware that the magic in that part of the tower is a bit unstable, so any items left in the prison will be lost. Would you like me to teleport you there now?

steps.player: Yes please.

steps.speaker: Pagida
steps.text: Very well, prepare yourself.

steps.player: No thanks.

steps.speaker: Pagida
steps.text: I'll be here if you change your mind.

perhaps-the-archives-are-incomplete-inve.text: You notice some writing carved into the floor beside the skeleton: 'Lizards on the mountain. Do not trust the King. The Altar is a lie.'

perhaps-the-archives-are-incomplete-inve.player: Hmm. I should tell Phileas about this.

another-expedition-talking-to-phileas.speaker: Phileas Rimor
another-expedition-talking-to-phileas.text: Hello again. How is your quest going?

another-expedition-talking-to-phileas.player: So I went to the Library Historical Archive. I found out that King Shayzien VII ordered the construction of a prison there around the time the expedition was taking place.
I investigated the prison and in one of the cells I found a strange message.
'Lizards on the mountain. Do not trust the King. The Altar is a lie.'

another-expedition-talking-to-phileas.speaker: Phileas Rimor
another-expedition-talking-to-phileas.text: Lizards on the mountain? So it was true! Someone did return from that expedition! Do you think it was Magnus?

another-expedition-talking-to-phileas.speaker: Phileas Rimor
another-expedition-talking-to-phileas.text: That's a shame. I would have liked to have known what happened to him.

another-expedition-talking-to-phileas.speaker: Phileas Rimor
another-expedition-talking-to-phileas.text: That's one to dwell on later though. For now, we need to work out our next steps.

another-expedition-talking-to-phileas.speaker: Phileas Rimor
another-expedition-talking-to-phileas.text: Absolutely. We now know for sure that someone returned from that expedition, but we still don't really know why. We need to find out.

another-expedition-talking-to-phileas.player: But why does it matter? This all happened a thousand years ago. Anyone involved is long dead now.

another-expedition-talking-to-phileas.speaker: Phileas Rimor
another-expedition-talking-to-phileas.text: That doesn't mean it doesn't matter! This isn't just the chance to discover the truth about my ancestor. We also have the chance to expose the treachery of a former king!

another-expedition-talking-to-phileas.player: Okay, I see you feel strongly about this. What do you need me to do?

another-expedition-talking-to-phileas.speaker: Phileas Rimor
another-expedition-talking-to-phileas.text: If we're to find out what happened on that expedition, we're going to have to retrace its route. And by we, I mean you.

another-expedition-talking-to-phileas.player: Yeah, I had a feeling that would be the case.

another-expedition-talking-to-phileas.speaker: Phileas Rimor
another-expedition-talking-to-phileas.text: First things first, you'll need to talk to Lord Shayzien. He's ordered that any research work done on the mountain be approved by him first. You'll find him in the War Tent in the Shayzien Encampment to the

another-expedition-talking-to-phileas.player: I guess I'll be on my way then.

another-expedition-talking-to-phileas-ta.speaker: Phileas Rimor
another-expedition-talking-to-phileas-ta.text: Hello again. How is your quest going?

another-expedition-talking-to-phileas-ta.player: I still need to talk to Lord Shayzien.

another-expedition-talking-to-phileas-ta.speaker: Phileas Rimor
another-expedition-talking-to-phileas-ta.text: Well you'll find him in the War Tent in the Shayzien Encampment to the north.

another-expedition-talking-to-lord-shayz.player: I'd like to perform some research on Mount Quidamortem, but I need your permission to do so.

another-expedition-talking-to-lord-shayz.speaker: Lord Shiro Shayzien
another-expedition-talking-to-lord-shayz.text: Quite right. Quidamortem is a dangerous place and I don't want to be ordering my troops on any unnecessary rescue missions.

another-expedition-talking-to-lord-shayz.speaker: Lord Shiro Shayzien
another-expedition-talking-to-lord-shayz.text: So, tell me about your research.

another-expedition-talking-to-lord-shayz.player: Many years ago there was an expedition to Quidamortem ordered by King Shayzien VII. The expedition supposedly ended in failure.
But I have reason to believe that wasn't the case. I think something was discovered on that expedition. I want to find out what it was.

another-expedition-talking-to-lord-shayz.speaker: Lord Shiro Shayzien
another-expedition-talking-to-lord-shayz.text: Fair enough. I will approve your research, on one condition.

another-expedition-talking-to-lord-shayz.speaker: Lord Shiro Shayzien
another-expedition-talking-to-lord-shayz.text: If you discover anything, you will bring it to me first. King Shayzien VII was my ancestor and I want to be made aware of any discoveries that would present him in a bad light.

another-expedition-talking-to-lord-shayz.player: But surely the library should be made aware of any important discoveries?

another-expedition-talking-to-lord-shayz.speaker: Lord Shiro Shayzien
another-expedition-talking-to-lord-shayz.text: They will be made aware. But only after I have reviewed the discoveries first.

another-expedition-talking-to-lord-shayz.speaker: Lord Shiro Shayzien
another-expedition-talking-to-lord-shayz.text: Excellent. Consider your research approved. If you require assistance with your work, I'd recommend talking to Historian Duffy on Quidamortem. He's been researching the mountain for a while.

another-expedition-talking-to-lord-shayz.speaker: Lord Shiro Shayzien
another-expedition-talking-to-lord-shayz.text: Well if you require assistance, I'd recommend talking to Historian Duffy on Quidamortem. He's been researching the mountain for a while.

another-expedition-talking-to-historian-.speaker: Historian Duffy
another-expedition-talking-to-historian-.text: That's me. Do you need something?

another-expedition-talking-to-historian-.player: Lord Shayzien told me that you might be able to help with some research I'm doing.

another-expedition-talking-to-historian-.speaker: Historian Duffy
another-expedition-talking-to-historian-.text: I'm rather busy with my own research.

another-expedition-talking-to-historian-.player: I'm trying to retrace the steps of an expedition ordered by King Shayzien VII. I believe something important was found on that expedition, but I don't know what.

another-expedition-talking-to-historian-.speaker: Historian Duffy
another-expedition-talking-to-historian-.text: Interesting. So you don't know anything about what they found?

another-expedition-talking-to-historian-.player: I have a quote which I believe is from someone on the expedition.
'Lizards on the mountain. Do not trust the King. The Altar is a lie.'

another-expedition-talking-to-historian-.speaker: Historian Duffy
another-expedition-talking-to-historian-.text: Fascinating. We've been researching the lizard creatures here for a while now. We have reason to believe they are not of natural origin and may in fact have been created by Xeric or his followers.

another-expedition-talking-to-historian-.speaker: Historian Duffy
another-expedition-talking-to-historian-.text: But this quote of yours suggests the lizardmen may have existed during the time of King Shayzien VII, before Xeric's rule.

another-expedition-talking-to-historian-.speaker: Historian Duffy
another-expedition-talking-to-historian-.text: Yes. This is definitely worth pursuing. In fact, I think I know where we should begin.

another-expedition-talking-to-historian-.speaker: Historian Duffy
another-expedition-talking-to-historian-.text: We recently found a small crevice on the western face of the mountain. It seems to be manmade and appears to be older than the rest of the caves around here.

another-expedition-investigating-the-cre.player: This must be the crevice that Duffy mentioned. I'll need a rope to get in.

another-expedition-using-a-rope-on-the-c.text: You attach a rope to the crevice.
Do you want to enter the crevice? Any items left in there, including upon death, will be lost.

another-expedition-inspecting-the-unstab.text: As you approach the altar you hear a strange voice.

another-expedition-inspecting-the-unstab.speaker: Mysterious Voice
another-expedition-inspecting-the-unstab.text: Rickard! Turn away! Don't do this!

another-expedition-inspecting-the-unstab.player: Hmm, I wonder what that was about.
Oh well, I may as well go and tell Historian Duffy what I've found.

another-expedition-returning-to-duffy.text: If the player did not kill the Corrupt Lizardman:

steps.player: Hello.

steps.speaker: Historian Duffy
steps.text: Find anything in that cave?

steps.player: Not yet.

steps.speaker: Historian Duffy
steps.text: Well let us know when you do. It's on the western face of the mountain.

another-expedition-returning-to-duffy.text: If the player inspected the unstable altar:

another-expedition-returning-to-duffy.speaker: Historian Duffy
another-expedition-returning-to-duffy.text: Hello. Did you find anything in that cave?

another-expedition-returning-to-duffy.player: I did. There was a weird looking lizardman along with a strange altar.
Don't worry, I took care of it.

another-expedition-returning-to-duffy.speaker: Historian Duffy
another-expedition-returning-to-duffy.text: Well in that case, we'll go take a look.

another-expedition-talking-to-duffy-in-t.speaker: Historian Duffy
another-expedition-talking-to-duffy-in-t.text: This cave is quite fascinating. We could really be on to something big here.

another-expedition-talking-to-duffy-in-t.speaker: Historian Duffy
another-expedition-talking-to-duffy-in-t.text: We've never come across lizards like the ones in this cave before. It would appear that they are a previously undiscovered species.

another-expedition-talking-to-duffy-in-t.speaker: Historian Duffy
another-expedition-talking-to-duffy-in-t.text: That's nothing. The really interesting part is that these lizards appear to be directly related to the lizardmen that roam this region.

another-expedition-talking-to-duffy-in-t.player: So this is where the lizardmen came from?

another-expedition-talking-to-duffy-in-t.speaker: Historian Duffy
another-expedition-talking-to-duffy-in-t.text: It would appear so. That's not all though. This cave definitely predates Xeric, who we originally believed to be the creator of the lizardmen.

another-expedition-talking-to-duffy-in-t.speaker: Historian Duffy
another-expedition-talking-to-duffy-in-t.text: Impossible to say for sure, but with what we've already learnt about King Shayzien VII, I do wonder if he was the one responsible.

another-expedition-talking-to-duffy-in-t.player: But if King Shayzien VII did create the lizardmen, why did they fight for Xeric?

another-expedition-talking-to-duffy-in-t.speaker: Historian Duffy
another-expedition-talking-to-duffy-in-t.text: There are some who believe that King Shayzien VII and Xeric were one and the same. They claim that after his death, the King was resurrected by his followers, taking on the name Xeric.

another-expedition-talking-to-duffy-in-t.speaker: Historian Duffy
another-expedition-talking-to-duffy-in-t.text: Anyway, I'm going to carry on with my research. I'd recommend you talk to Gnosi. She's made some interesting discoveries of her own.

another-expedition-talking-to-gnosi.player: Hello. Duffy said you'd found something interesting.

another-expedition-talking-to-gnosi.speaker: Gnosi
another-expedition-talking-to-gnosi.text: The Dark Altar was the key to Xeric's power. Because of it, he was able to rule Kourend unopposed for nearly a hundred years. His reign was so dark, it became known as the Age of Strife.

another-expedition-talking-to-gnosi.speaker: Gnosi
another-expedition-talking-to-gnosi.text: Once he was finally defeated, Xeric came to Quidamortem and built the Chambers of Xeric deep below the mountain.

another-expedition-talking-to-gnosi.speaker: Gnosi
another-expedition-talking-to-gnosi.text: For many years we've tried to work out how he managed to survive out here without the power of the Dark Altar. Thanks to this cave, I think we've found the answer.

another-expedition-talking-to-gnosi.speaker: Gnosi
another-expedition-talking-to-gnosi.text: This altar, it seems to give off the same power as the Dark Altar.

another-expedition-talking-to-gnosi.player: So this altar was how Xeric kept his power after he was defeated?

another-expedition-talking-to-gnosi.speaker: Gnosi
another-expedition-talking-to-gnosi.text: It appears to be manmade. I believe this altar was created to amplify the power of the Dark Altar, allowing it to reach areas it previously couldn't.

another-expedition-talking-to-gnosi.speaker: Gnosi
another-expedition-talking-to-gnosi.text: This discovery does bring about an intriguing question though.

another-expedition-talking-to-gnosi.speaker: Gnosi
another-expedition-talking-to-gnosi.text: The altar here is still giving out power. That means Xeric could have potentially used it to live for hundreds of years after his defeat. It's long been believed that Xeric eventually died here, but what if he didn't?

another-expedition-talking-to-gnosi.speaker: Gnosi
another-expedition-talking-to-gnosi.text: Indeed. I'm going to stay here and continue working. Do you mind heading to the library to let them know what we've discovered.

another-expedition-talking-to-gnosi.player: Actually, Lord Shayzien asked me to go to him first with any discoveries.

another-expedition-talking-to-gnosi.speaker: Gnosi
another-expedition-talking-to-gnosi.text: Hmm, I can see why he would take an interest. Very well, go let him know what we've found.

finishing-up-reporting-to-lord-shayzien.speaker: Lord Shiro Shayzien
finishing-up-reporting-to-lord-shayzien.text: How is your research going citizen?

finishing-up-reporting-to-lord-shayzien.player: We've discovered a small cave on the western face of Quidamortem. It's manmade and it predates the time of Xeric.
Inside, we found an altar. It seems to be giving off the same power as the Dark Altar.
We also discovered a unique lizard species, one that shares many similarities with the lizardmen.
It seems that this cave was the origin of the lizardmen. The fact that it predates Xeric suggests the lizardmen do as well.

finishing-up-reporting-to-lord-shayzien.speaker: Lord Shiro Shayzien
finishing-up-reporting-to-lord-shayzien.text: You believe they were the creation of my ancestor?

finishing-up-reporting-to-lord-shayzien.player: Hard to say for sure. It would make sense though.
From the evidence we have, I believe that King Shayzien VII ordered an expedition to Quidamortem, hoping to discover a suitable species for his lizardman project.
Once the expedition found one, he had them killed to keep the discovery a secret.
Not definitive, but there's a lot of evidence.

finishing-up-reporting-to-lord-shayzien.speaker: Lord Shiro Shayzien
finishing-up-reporting-to-lord-shayzien.text: So you claim. However, you never actually told me where this evidence came from.

finishing-up-reporting-to-lord-shayzien.player: It started with a parcel delivered to Phileas Rimor. It contained a journal written by King Shayzien VII himself. The journal mentioned creatures on Quidamortem.

finishing-up-reporting-to-lord-shayzien.speaker: Lord Shiro Shayzien
finishing-up-reporting-to-lord-shayzien.text: A parcel? King Shayzien VII's journal was delivered in a parcel? Who sent it?

finishing-up-reporting-to-lord-shayzien.speaker: Lord Shiro Shayzien
finishing-up-reporting-to-lord-shayzien.text: Well you need to find out. Go to Phileas Rimor and retrieve this parcel. I need to see it for myself.

finishing-up-reporting-to-lord-shayzien.player: Eugh, so much walking. Fine, I'll go see Phileas.

finishing-up-reporting-to-lord-shayzien-.speaker: Lord Shiro Shayzien
finishing-up-reporting-to-lord-shayzien-.text: Do you have the parcel citizen?

finishing-up-reporting-to-lord-shayzien-.speaker: Lord Shiro Shayzien
finishing-up-reporting-to-lord-shayzien-.text: Well go and fetch it then. I need to see it for myself.

finishing-up-entering-phileas-home.player: Err, this doesn't look good. I'd better tell Lord Shayzien.

finishing-up-returning-to-lord-shayzien.speaker: Lord Shiro Shayzien
finishing-up-returning-to-lord-shayzien.text: Do you have the parcel citizen?

finishing-up-returning-to-lord-shayzien.player: I'm afraid not. I went to see Phileas but his home was trashed and he was gone.

finishing-up-returning-to-lord-shayzien.speaker: Lord Shiro Shayzien
finishing-up-returning-to-lord-shayzien.text: I'll open an investigation into this immediately. Hopefully we can find out what happened to Phileas.

finishing-up-returning-to-lord-shayzien.speaker: Lord Shiro Shayzien
finishing-up-returning-to-lord-shayzien.text: I'm afraid that without that parcel we don't have anything to link King Shayzien VII to your discoveries.

finishing-up-returning-to-lord-shayzien.speaker: Lord Shiro Shayzien
finishing-up-returning-to-lord-shayzien.text: However, the rest of your research is still valid. I'll contact the research team on the mountain and make sure their discoveries are documented in the Arceuus Library.

finishing-up-returning-to-lord-shayzien.speaker: Lord Shiro Shayzien
finishing-up-returning-to-lord-shayzien.text: You've done enough for now citizen. I'll be in touch if we require your assistance again. For now, here is payment for your time.
